author: 24LopezR
body:
#### PR description:

This PR introduces a new digitization + local hit reconstruction pipeline ready for running on GPU. This includes new digi/rechit DataFormats based on SoA structure, Alpaka modules for local reconstruction, and dedicated validation scripts for the new SoA formats.

More details about the motivation and technical implementation can be found in [1] (major timing calibrations were fixed after the talk).

Important notes:
1. The standard CMSSW chain is unaffected. This PR only introduces the fundamental pieces for further development and integration of the new pipeline.
2. The new SoA formats are not saved persistently. They are only used internally for validation against the default format.
3. The new digi SortedCollections, that serve as an previous step to the SoA data format, are added to the sim event content.
4. Differences are expected between SoA and SortedCollection formats, particularly in ETL digi ToA and BTL digi charge distributions (see [1]).

[1] https://indico.cern.ch/event/1695985/#3-digitization-and-reconstruct

#### PR validation:

This development has been vaildated with several events from a TTbar 14TeV workflow (34434.0) and MinBias 14TeV workflow (34440.0). No differences have been observed in the standard CMSSW digi/rechit formats.

- 34434.0 TTbar_14TeV_TuneCP5_Run4D121
- 34440.0 MinBias_14TeV_pythia8_TuneCP5_Run4D121
